raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
-this is a follow-up to #44726. I encountered a compilation error in `sglang-bench/tests/grpc.rs` .
These four new HiCache RPCs were missing from the benchmark's `SglangService` mock, causing `cargo test --workspace` to fail with E0046.

-it also adds explicit `Status::unimplemented` handlers, matching the mock's other unused RPCs.

## Tests

Passed locally from `rust/`:

- `cargo test --locked -p sglang-bench --test grpc`
- `cargo test --locked --workspace`
- `cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`

`git diff --check` also passed.

## Checklist

- [x] Run pre-commit checks.
- [x] Validate the existing gRPC integration test and workspace tests.
- [x] Follow existing code style.

nodes.body: @rainj-me could you review this follow-up to #44726 and enable CI? The gRPC integration test, workspace tests, all-target Clippy, and pre-commit pass locally. Hosted lint also passed; the remaining failures report a missing `run-ci` label.
